question: How do devotees worship by action?
premises: They renounce all actions into the Lord.
They are devoted to the Lord.
They meditate on the Lord through yoga.
inference: Devotees worship by dedicating all actions and meditating on the Lord.
uncertainties: The fused form ananyenaiva is treated as one token.
plain_english: Those who renounce all actions into me, devoted to me, meditate on me through yoga and worship.
